APP.NAME: Gravity Guy
APP.TITLE: Play | Gravity Guy
APP.START_COPY: The last courier on the orbital line has one rule: never stop moving. Somewhere behind, a jetpack Shiba is always catching up.
APP.OVER_COPY: The Shiba, the left edge or the void caught you. Flip around obstacles and slow platforms to stay ahead on your next run.
APP.GUIDE_FLIP: Press Space / ↑ or tap the playfield while touching a platform to reverse gravity. Land before flipping again; midair taps are ignored.
APP.GUIDE_AVOID: Blocks stop you while the map keeps moving. Flip free before the Shiba catches you or you hit the left edge. Later, alternate around slow patches, launch off long boosted rails, and time short zigzag ledges before they end. The Shiba predicts safe routes and respawns if it falls.
APP.GUIDE_SCORE: Every run has a new course and setting. Distance is your score; your best stays in this browser.
APP.PLAYFIELD: Gravity runner playfield. Use Space or Arrow Up, or tap while touching a platform, to flip gravity.
APP.GUIDE_PLATFORMS: Green strips appear after obstacle clusters or before later gaps. They accelerate the oncoming map and help you recover. Purple strips between block patterns slow you down and pull you toward the Shiba.
APP.ROTATE_COPY: Turn your phone or tablet sideways to use Gravity Guy. Local runs pause until you resume. Online countdowns and rounds keep going while you rotate.
APP.HELP_DESCRIPTION: Learn the controls and how to stay ahead of the Shiba.
APP.GUIDE_PAUSE: P / Esc to pause or resume. On touch devices, use the play/pause icon. Opening Help or Settings, switching tabs, or rotating upright pauses the run.

ONLINE.LEAVE_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: You will leave this room. An active round keeps going for the other runners.
